judgment.notes: BG001 applies componentwise because H001 gives finite positive dimensions and H002 gives C∞ regularity on the open domain R^n×(0,∞). H004 is an identity throughout that domain, so both time and each spatial coordinate can be differentiated twice locally. All D001–D004 guards H001,H002 are direct inputs. There are no E/M applications; the mention of mixed derivatives is unnecessary to this calculation.

Twice differentiating u·u=1 gives exactly the three families of identities in F001. With w=u_tt−Δ_xu=a u, symmetry and bilinearity give u_t·w=a(u·u_t)=0. Taking u·w gives a=u·u_tt−Σ_j u·∂_{x_jx_j}u=Σ_j|∂_{x_j}u|²−|u_t|² since u·u=1. Substitution proves the full vector equation. The same algebra for an arbitrary scalar satisfying w=a u proves the final conditional uniqueness clause. No derivative of a is taken and no limit interchange occurs.

S001 uses only H001,H002,H004 and BG001; S002 uses H005,H004 and the earlier F001, with D004 expanding the Laplacian as a finite sum. The arbitrary x,t remain in scope throughout. H005 at that (x,t) supplies the local scalar witness. The tangency and vector conclusions contain no private scalar, so existential elimination is legitimate. The final assertion about every satisfying scalar is conditional on its own normality equation, justified by the explicitly repeated calculation; that premise does not escape. All four direct H inputs are used, with no circular or future fact.
